text:
tara: Quick sync after the postmortem — we keep seeing the same triad: accept-handshake timeouts -> partial chunk emission -> client reconnect storms. Need to split ownership and lock dates for the remediation sprint. Short answers pls.

liam: I'll own the server acceptance path hardening (ITEM A). Plan: increase handshake deadline from 3s -> 6s behind a feature flag, add per-worker accept-queue depth metric. Drafting a short RFC now. ETA Mon.

so phia: (typo, corrected) sophia: I'll take ITEM B (stream integrity signaling). Proposal: emit explicit terminal markers and a checksum header so clients can detect truncation reliably. Will add SDK hooks too. ETA Wed EOD.

liam: For acceptance changes we should also add a canary that only affects 1% of traffic for 24h. Roll-forward only if partial_rate <= baseline.

tara: Good. ITEM C (client behavior): implement client-side exponential backoff + connection cap. @sophia can you coordinate with client-sdk owners?

sophia: Yep. Will add backoff to python/node sdks and publish a beta tag. Tests: local harness + 10k simulated clients.

eng-infra: We can provision a 4-shard harness in the staging cluster. Need ticket with required qps and retention.

tara: I'll open the infra ticket and cc @eng-infra. Also creating a short list of acceptance criteria:
- stream.partial_rate measurement added
- stream.accept.queue.p95 and p99
- client.max_conns enforced in SDKs
- canary rollout plan documented

liam: Hypothesis for root cause: rapid reconnects leave kernel socket queues with half-open entries leading to delayed accept handling. Plan: capture SO_ACCEPT_QUEUE stats + tcp_queue drops per worker. Will attach logs.

sophia: For the sentinel/header approach, edge-case: tool-calls that spawn external requests may legitimately pause without EOS. We'll include an allowlist and TTL semantics.

tara: Owner map so far: ITEM A = liam, ITEM B = sophia, ITEM C = sophia (SDK), ITEM D = tara (dashboards & runbook), ITEM E = eng-infra (harness).

ci-bot: Canary scheduled: conn-resilience-v2-canary -> 3267900000, shards: staging-1..3 :rocket:

liam: Rollback rules proposal: immediate rollback if canary partial_rate > 2x baseline OR any production-grade 5xx spike > 0.3%.

eng-infra: Granted quota for 4-shard harness; created infra ticket INF-4829.

tara: Timeline: metrics + logging changes by Mon, SDK beta by Wed, harness runs Thu, canary Fri 01:00-05:00 UTC. Full rollout conditional on canary health next Tue.

sophia: I'll post SDK beta release notes and sample snippet for how to handle partial_response sentinel. Example:```js
const stream = client.stream(...);
stream.on('partial_response', () => { /* backoff & retry logic */ });
```

liam: I'll add Grafana panels for stream.accept.queue and stream.partial_rate and wire alerts to the incident channel.

tara: Runbook action: short step-by-step "If partial responses spike" for oncall. Will include queries and quick remediation steps (toggle flag, rollback). I'll draft.

liam: ack.

sophia: ack.

eng-infra: ack — will support harness runs and monitoring hooks.

tara: Closing: weekly check-in scheduled (Fridays 09:30 PT) until issues are closed. I'll update the postmortem doc with owner table and timeline. Link to PM doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/streams-3-14-updates :memo:

ci-bot: Note: INF-4829 and canary job created.

tara: Thanks everyone, ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
